rule: Early check-in before 14:00 may be noted but cannot be guaranteed unless the assigned room is inspected and released.
VIP quiet-room preferences require room blocking after manager approval.
Dietary restrictions must be sent to F&B by 17:00 one day before breakfast service.
Projector setup must be completed 120 minutes before meeting start.
Airport transfer requires flight number, arrival time, passenger count, and phone number.
Company invoice requires billing contact, legal company name, tax ID, and billing address.
Free room upgrades require manager approval; OTA bookings are not guaranteed an upgrade.
High-floor room preferences are honored subject to availability and readiness.
Parking requires the vehicle plate and arrival time, and is subject to availability.
Long-stay discounts require revenue manager approval based on the occupancy forecast.
Lost-and-found requires the front desk to check the log and storage and dispatch housekeeping to inspect the room.
Maintenance requests are dispatched to the on-call technician, subject to staff availability.
